top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - Not Listed (26 TAC §HRC42.052(c) - AP Illegal Operation - No)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Regular care is being provided to 2 unrelated children.

top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have their hands washed following a diaper change.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The use zone of a rotating device was deficient as observed during inspection. Another play equipment and a table were less than 6 feet away from the rotating device.    NOTE: This was corrected during inspection. The table and play equipment was moved to comply with use zone.

top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Bodies of Water Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3701(9))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A television was not anchored to the table it was sitting on.
